nodes.label: Single-Purpose Action Classes
nodes.rationale: Extract discrete business operations into invokable Action classes for better organization.

nodes.label: Constructor Dependency Injection
nodes.rationale: Always use constructor injection; avoid app() or resolve() inside classes.

nodes.label: defer() for Post-Response Work
nodes.rationale: Use defer() for lightweight tasks that run after the HTTP response is sent, avoiding queue overhead.

nodes.label: Context Facade
nodes.rationale: Pass request-scoped data through the lifecycle (middleware, controllers, jobs, logs) without manual argument passing.

nodes.label: Concurrency::run()
nodes.rationale: Run independent operations in parallel using child processes.
